service.port.description: SMTP listening port (used in init script)

service.runas.description: User account under which qpsmtpd runs (used in init script)

service.enabled.description:
Whether qpsmtpd service is enabled ('true' or 'false'; used in init script)
      Valid values: false, true, 0, 1
      Default: false
      Enum: ["false", "true", "0", "1"]
      Example: true
    }

sample_values.description:
Sample values that reproduce the original default config file exactly.
      service.port: 25
      service.runas: qpsmtpd
      service.enabled: false
    }
